valuable: Grandma's old gold watch is so valuable that she keeps it locked away.
Why is a rare stamp so valuable to people who collect them?
Good advice from a teacher is valuable when you start something new.
adorable: Everyone wanted to cuddle the adorable baby rabbit.
What an adorable little duckling, so fluffy and soft!
Isn't the baby hedgehog adorable when it sniffs a leaf?
remarkably: How remarkably still the pond was, without one ripple!
After the party, the kitchen was remarkably spotless, with not one crumb left.
The pumpkin in our garden was remarkably enormous, and we all stared!
enjoyable: The film was so enjoyable that we laughed all the way home.
What an enjoyable game of rounders we had on the field!
Our party was enjoyable, with lots of games and a big cake.
reasonable: Mum said that sharing the last biscuit was a reasonable idea.
We all agreed that the rule was fair and reasonable.
Going to bed early before a big day is a reasonable plan.
noticeable: There is a noticeable gap on the shelf where the book was.
Her bright yellow coat made her noticeable in the crowd.
Is the stain on my jumper noticeable from the back?
comfortable: I put a cushion behind my back to feel more comfortable.
The armchair by the window was so comfortable that I fell asleep.
Wrap yourself in this fluffy blanket and get comfortable!
fashionable: Long ago, tall hats were fashionable, but now few people wear them.
Bright colours are fashionable this year, so the shop is full of them.
Everyone at school wants the fashionable new trainers this autumn.
comfortably: The dog stretched out comfortably in his big soft basket.
Can you fit comfortably in the tent with your sleeping bag?
Please sit comfortably on the carpet and listen to the story.
reasonably: We talked calmly and reasonably until we agreed on a game.
She reasonably said we should wait until the rain stopped.
He asked reasonably for a little more time to finish.

rejected.s: A map is valuable when you are lost on a long walk.
rejected.reason: checker: Being lost on a walk could worry young children, so it is dropped to be safe.

rejected.s: My puppy looked adorable asleep with his paws over his nose.
rejected.reason: checker: A sleeping puppy could just as well have 'looked comfortable'. (also fits: comfortable)

rejected.s: It was remarkably quiet in the library, even though the room was full.
rejected.reason: checker: 'Reasonably quiet' also makes sense here. (also fits: reasonably)

rejected.s: The little seedling grew remarkably tall in only one week.
rejected.reason: checker: 'Grew reasonably tall' is also possible, so the clue is not strict enough. (also fits: reasonably)

rejected.s: Although it was December, the day was remarkably warm.
rejected.reason: checker: 'Reasonably warm' fits just as naturally. (also fits: reasonably)

rejected.s: Baking biscuits with Gran is always an enjoyable afternoon.
rejected.reason: machine rule 4: capital word not allowed: Gran

rejected.s: Was the school trip to the farm enjoyable?
rejected.reason: checker: No clue in the sentence, and 'valuable' would also fit a school trip. (also fits: valuable)

rejected.s: Is it reasonable to wear shorts when it is snowing?
rejected.reason: checker: 'Is it comfortable to wear shorts' also works. (also fits: comfortable)

rejected.s: The bright red door was very noticeable among the grey houses.
rejected.reason: machine rule 4: not on the word lists: among

rejected.s: Are these new trainers comfortable enough to wear all day?
rejected.reason: checker: 'Fashionable enough' also works for new trainers. (also fits: fashionable)

rejected.s: My brother ran remarkably far on sports day, which surprised us all.
rejected.reason: checker: 'Ran reasonably far' is a very common phrase, so a child could fairly put 'reasonably' in the gap. (also fits: reasonably)

rejected.s: My gran's old teapot is remarkably tiny, smaller than a walnut!
rejected.reason: checker: A teapot smaller than a walnut is hard to believe and may confuse a child.

rejected.s: Why was the playground remarkably silent, without one single sound, at lunchtime?
rejected.reason: checker: The question is awkward and unnatural, and 'without one single sound' repeats 'silent'.

rejected.s: The snow was remarkably deep, taller than our little dog!
rejected.reason: checker: 'Reasonably deep' is a natural phrase, so the gap is not clear enough. (also fits: reasonably)
